purpose: Remove two ambiguities that would otherwise hide inside a PPO run that appeared to work: what 'O3 controls the remainder' means across carry phases, and what 'post-onset credit only' means across the optimization path.

o3_activation.set_true_at: the first C_fork firing in the episode
o3_activation.why_not_detector_state: CForkDetector resets its per-carry-phase latch when possession ends. An action selector keyed on detector state would hand control BACK to G0 at the next pickup, silently producing a different experiment -- multiple O3 segments per episode, each requiring its own GAE boundary. The frozen protocol says O3 controls the remainder of the episode, so the latch must be episode-level and one-way.

control.after_activation: O3 acts for the remainder of the episode

optimization_domain.rule: only transitions collected while o3_active == true participate in PPO optimization
optimization_domain.implementation_requirement: a hard indexing boundary over the entire optimization path, NOT a weight of zero
optimization_domain.why_not_zero_weight: Zero-weighted samples remain present in batch statistics -- advantage normalization, clip fractions, entropy means -- so the leak survives a loss that looks correctly masked.

gae.computed_on: the O3 segment, from the handoff step h to terminal
gae.why: Zeroing the value at h would inject a false terminal boundary and bias every advantage in the segment. GAE propagates backward from future transitions, so advantages at and after h never draw on pre-handoff rewards; the boundary is about which transitions form the optimization dataset, not about truncating the value estimate.

no_trigger_episodes.note: Roughly 30% of carry phases contain no qualifying fork, and some episodes contain no carry phase at all. These consume simulator time without contributing gradient.

hard_assertions.rule: asserted directly, never inferred from a mask after the fact
hard_assertions.on_violation: abort the run; a violated invariant means the optimization domain is not what this document says it is

architecture_note.observed: this model uses a separate CentralizedCritic consuming global state, while actor_cnn is the actor's own encoder
architecture_note.consequence: the shared-trunk leak, where critic gradients reach actor features, does not apply to the current model
architecture_note.why: It keeps the experiment definition architecture-agnostic, prevents pre-handoff states from training a component used to score post-handoff behavior, and stops a future model change from silently reopening the hole.

throughput_diagnostics.why: Effective O3 sample throughput must be measured rather than inferred. If a nominal 10,000-step rollout yields 3,800 post-handoff transitions, PPO received 3,800 useful samples, which bears on training speed and on how many environment steps the canonical run needs.

summary: G0 chooses the natural prefix; at the first C_fork, O3 owns the rest of the episode; only that suffix teaches O3.
immutability: After any O3 training outcome is observed, none of the above may change: the activation latch, the control rule, the optimization domain, the GAE boundary, the assertions, or the throughput definitions.
